# dotfiles (hub/)

Personal dotfiles: shell, editor, terminal, and tooling configs.
Directory-per-tool layout. Symlinked into $HOME via the setup substrate.

## Setup substrate (fresh-system provisioning)

Provisions a fresh system (container, laptop, server) via pixi.

- `pixi.toml`, `pixi.lock`     — pixi manifest + lockfile (at repo root)
- `setup/bootstrap.sh`         — install pixi itself
- `setup/scripts/`             — symlink + tmux-plugin scripts
- `setup/README.md`            — full setup docs + profile catalog

Quick start:
```
bash setup/bootstrap.sh
export PATH="$HOME/.pixi/bin:$PATH"
pixi run -e <profile> setup    # profiles: container-slim, laptop
exec bash
```

## Source code structure

| Directory | Purpose |
|-----------|---------|
| `bash/`, `zsh/`         | Shell configs |
| `nvim/`, `vim/`         | Editor configs (nvim repo is separate; symlinked in) |
| `git/`                  | Git config |
| `terminal/ghostty/`     | Ghostty terminal config |
| `terminal/tmux/`        | tmux config |
| `terminal/starter-kits/`| Self-contained shareable kits for friends/students |
| `starship/`             | Prompt config |
| `bin/`                  | Utility scripts |
| `host_laptop/`          | macOS-specific runtime config (sourced by shell) |
| `host_longreads/`       | longreads-specific runtime config |
| `host_talapas/`         | talapas-specific runtime config |
| `kanata/`               | Keyboard remapping (Mac); standalone setup in `kanata/README.setup` |
| `markdown/glow/`        | glow markdown viewer theme (catppuccin-mocha) |
| `nerd-fonts/`           | Manual font install notes |
| `inputrc`               | readline config |

## Legacy install lore

- `setup.sh`                            — pre-pixi Mac install log (rough notes)
- `setup.d/260310-setup-bumble.sh`      — pre-pixi Linux install log (bumble, ubuntu 24.04)

Both are preserved for reference but superseded by `setup/`.
